scientific_question: Can the measured high-byte redundancy of the loss-closing FP16 ambient Muon state be represented by a fixed-width dictionary plus exact exceptions, small enough to beat E5M8 and structured for parallel GPU decode?

causal_authorization.low_byte_finding: The lower eight bits retain 7.99545 conditional bits, so they must remain literal; the compressible object is the high byte.
causal_authorization.systems_finding: Variable-length CPU zlib is too slow, so the next candidate must use fixed-width indices, an exception bitmap, and block-local random access.

theory.word_split: For each exact FP16 word w, store low=w&255 verbatim and encode high=w>>8.
theory.dictionary: For each registered region, store the K most frequent high-byte values. Every coordinate stores a fixed k=log2(K)-bit table index and a one-bit exception flag. Exceptions additionally store the literal high byte.
theory.exactness: The decoder reconstructs high from table[index] when flag=0 and from the literal exception stream when flag=1, then returns (high<<8)|low. Every source uint16 word must round-trip exactly.
theory.byte_model: N low-byte bytes + ceil(N*k/8) index bytes + ceil(N/8) exception-bitmap bytes + E literal bytes + dictionary bytes + 32-bit block exception offsets + container metadata.
theory.parallel_decode: One GPU block owns one coordinate block. Ballot/popcount over the exception bitmap gives each escaped lane its literal rank; all other lanes use a constant/shared-memory table lookup. There is no serial entropy decoder.
non_claims: This terminal-state capacity audit does not establish codebook stability through training.
It does not establish GPU encode/decode speed or >=20% MFU.
It does not authorize a loss endpoint because any bit-exact implementation is loss-identical by construction.

dictionary_granularities.global: One K-byte high-byte table for all 24 matrices.
dictionary_granularities.scope: One table for c_fc and one for c_proj.
dictionary_granularities.matrix: One table for each of the 24 matrices.
dictionary_granularities.block: One table per decode block, selected from that block only.

frozen_candidates.tie_breaking: Within a region, equal-count symbols are ordered by ascending uint8 value.
frozen_candidates.padding: Each matrix starts every packed stream on a byte boundary; no cross-matrix bit carry is allowed.
frozen_candidates.metadata: Count all dictionaries, 32-bit exception offsets per decode block plus terminal offset, 16 bytes per matrix descriptor, and a 64-byte container header.

measurements: dictionary coverage and escape fraction globally, per scope, per matrix, and per decode block
exact bytes for low literals, indices, exception bitmap, exception literals, dictionaries, block offsets, and metadata
bits per coordinate, total MLP-training bytes, and reduction versus dense FP32 weight plus momentum
byte-exact source/decoded SHA-256 for every registered candidate
scalar reference encode/decode wall time as a correctness diagnostic only, not a GPU performance claim

decision_gate.primary_selection: Minimum total exact bytes among passing candidates; ties choose larger decode blocks, then coarser dictionary granularity, then smaller K.
decision_gate.performance_control: Among passing candidates within 2% of the primary byte size, select the candidate with largest decode block, then coarsest dictionary granularity, then smallest K.
decision_gate.if_pass: Authorize implementation only of the primary and, if distinct, performance-control CUDA codec. Require exact randomized/special-word/checkpoint/resume tests and an exact-config encode-plus-decode preflight at >=20% MFU. No loss endpoint is authorized.
decision_gate.if_fail: Reject fixed-width high-byte dictionaries. Retain FP16 ambient momentum as the measured floor and move to a temporal/shared learned predictor only after a new preregistered information audit.

execution_policy.implementation_before_execution: Commit this plan, add a standalone read-only capacity audit with exact codec tests, Git-sync to PRO6, and verify the checkpoint and parent-result hashes.
execution_policy.monitoring: Expected below five minutes and foreground-polled. If it exceeds five minutes, stop foreground polling and attach one terminal/error-only @Codex watchdog.
execution_policy.resource_policy: CPU and host RAM only; do not occupy GPU0 or write checkpoints.
